description: This file defines a FastAPI router for gap analysis related to roles in a career planning application. It includes an endpoint to compute gap analysis between user competencies and role requirements, utilizing external services like a database client and authentication modules.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: Client for interacting with Supabase, supporting user mode operations.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResponse
classes.description: Response schema for gap analysis results.

classes.name: GapItem
classes.description: Schema representing individual gap items in the analysis.

methods.name: compute_gap(role_id: int, authorization: str = Header(...), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to compute gap analysis for a specified role ID, returning insights about competency gaps.

ctags.name: compute_gap
ctags.pattern: /^async def compute_gap(role_id: int, authorization: str = Header(...), user: AuthUser = Depends(c/
ctags.signature: (role_id: int, authorization: str = Header(...), user: AuthUser = Depends(current_user))
